subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as an official qwen provider/config/auth contract in the bundled qwen plugin?
rationale: The patch is now coherent, but it adds a new provider id, auth choices, env var, model catalog, outbound hosts, and a legacy custom-provider owner that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Accept bundled Token Plan
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks if maintainers want qwen to own Token Plan onboarding, catalog, and the bailian-token-plan custom-owner boundary.

options.title: Require more vendor proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for maintainer-selected live model/region proof before accepting the official contract.

options.title: Route outside bundled qwen
options.body: Pause or close this PR and ask for a ClawHub/plugin package if OpenClaw should not own another Alibaba provider contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled Token Plan
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks if maintainers want qwen to own Token Plan onboarding, catalog, and the bailian-token-plan custom-owner boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee and has both qwen-provider history and latest branch authorship.
